20_prime_portrait_cards.evidence: Equal photographic cards communicate a curated set or shared status.

22_single_measurement.condition: when the stated value is a rate or a built total
when the value marks a specific dated occurrence

23_portrait_scatter.evidence: Portrait position on two axes communicates a relationship.
Native bounds are x 0–1600 and y 32–60.
23_portrait_scatter.condition: when each axis represents a distinct qualifying threshold

24_dense_vertical_bars.evidence: Vertical bars show changes across a long sequence against a threshold.
24_dense_vertical_bars.condition: when bars mark unbroken presence above the threshold

25_career_value_list.condition: when the ledger ends in a summed career total
when periods represent an unbroken consecutive span

26_mirrored_stat_compare.evidence: Mirrored text comparisons around one person emphasize change without scaling the body.

27_rank_context_panel.evidence: A dominant subject, ranking list and supporting peer context explain standing.

28_stat_profile_cards.evidence: Full-body cards offer side-by-side text comparisons with equal visual roles.

30_dense_rank_bars.evidence: Dense horizontal bars compare a single quantity.
Inspect the configured threshold and ranking order
30_dense_rank_bars.condition: when a threshold line is configured

31_greatest_team_scatter.condition: when axes represent two qualifying thresholds

32_record_height_bars.evidence: Bars scale to the largest supplied value but have an 80-pixel minimum height.
32_record_height_bars.condition: when bars represent distinct named peers rather than a summed group

34_superteam_bar_compare.evidence: Paired vertical bar charts compare two cohorts on a shared labeled scale.
34_superteam_bar_compare.condition: when each cohort bar is a summed group total
when each cohort's members are shown individually rather than summed

35_shooting_portrait_matrix.evidence: Use one consistently defined measure and denominator

35_shooting_portrait_matrix.condition: when the displayed metric is a rate

36_four_portrait_cards.evidence: Four framed portrait cards compare text values using equal image treatment.
36_four_portrait_cards.condition: when one card is narratively the focal entity

37_fullbody_impact_lineup.evidence: A shared baseline creates a lineup; figure sizes are fixed stylistic placements.

38_matchup_win_list.evidence: Repeated head-to-head rows create an outcome narrative around a featured person.

39_five_player_impact.evidence: Only names and portraits are active person data.
Three labeled bands communicate membership or tier placement.
39_five_player_impact.condition: when band sizes are counts summing to the full cohort

40_two_era_fullbody_compare.evidence: Two large full-body figures frame aligned numeric comparisons.
Align units, reference dates and metric definitions across the two columns.
40_two_era_fullbody_compare.condition: when the two figures are the same subject across two eras

41_five_value_headshots.evidence: Five headshots with prominent numbers create a simple comparison.
41_five_value_headshots.condition: when one headshot is the narrative focus among peers

42_playoff_rank_grid.evidence: Numbered positions and text values encode order; portrait size stays fixed.
